schema.name: KivaLoan
schema.doc: CDC event value for raw_data.kiva_loans. Mirrors the PostgreSQL table schema. All nullable fields use Avro union [null, <type>] with default null to allow forward-compatible schema evolution — adding new nullable columns does not break existing consumers.

fields.name: funded_amount
fields.doc: Amount funded — serialized as string per decimal.handling.mode=string to avoid floating-point precision loss

fields.name: loan_amount
fields.doc: Total loan amount requested — serialized as string

fields.name: town
fields.doc: Town or city of the borrower

fields.name: posted_date
fields.doc: Timestamp when the loan was posted on Kiva — serialized as ISO-8601 string by Debezium

fields.name: ingested_at
fields.doc: Audit: timestamp when the row was ingested into PostgreSQL

fields.name: __op
fields.doc: CDC operation type added by Debezium SMT: c=create, u=update, d=delete, r=read (snapshot)

fields.name: __ts_ms
fields.doc: CDC event timestamp in milliseconds since epoch, added by Debezium SMT

fields.name: __deleted
fields.doc: Soft-delete marker added by Debezium delete.handling.mode=rewrite. Value is 'true' for deleted rows.
